boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Coral Gables destinations on practical off-campus corridors, each paired with a directly documented reason to go.

cards.title: Shops at Merrick Park
cards.subtitle: San Lorenzo Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the San Lorenzo Avenue frontage to browse the two-level outdoor center, then use its listed restaurants, shops, cinema, or gym as your reason to stop.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor retail center with several documented activity options.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Shops at Merrick Park at 358 San Lorenzo Avenue and identifies restaurants, boutiques, department stores, a movie theater, and a gym.
cards.source_title: Shops at Merrick Park | Coral Gables
cards.access_notes: At 358 San Lorenzo Ave.; listed hours are Monday–Saturday 11 a.m.–8 p.m. and Sunday noon–6 p.m.

cards.title: Books & Books
cards.subtitle: Aragon Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Head to 265 Aragon Avenue for the bookstore; check its events listing before you go if you want to pair browsing with a scheduled author program.
cards.short_summary: A named independent bookstore on Aragon Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Books & Books identifies its Coral Gables bookstore at 265 Aragon Avenue and publishes a location-specific events listing.
cards.access_notes: The official contact page lists Coral Gables store hours through 11 p.m. most days; confirm event details separately.

cards.title: Coral Gables Art Cinema
cards.subtitle: Aragon Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the cinema schedule to choose a screening, then find the theater between Ponce de Leon Boulevard and Salzedo Street on Aragon Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit cinema with a documented Aragon Avenue location.
cards.evidence_claim: Coral Gables Art Cinema states that it is at 260 Aragon Avenue, between Ponce de Leon Boulevard and Salzedo Street.
cards.access_notes: At 260 Aragon Ave.; the official page notes a covered garage next door and street parking nearby.

cards.title: Coral Gables Museum
cards.subtitle: Aragon Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan an exhibition or tour visit at the former police and fire station, using the museum’s programs to focus your walk through the Aragon Avenue block.
cards.short_summary: A museum centered on Coral Gables architecture, planning, and history.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says the Coral Gables Museum offers exhibitions, collections, educational offerings, lectures, tours, publications, and special events at 285 Aragon Avenue.
cards.access_notes: At 285 Aragon Ave.; the City lists wheelchair access, guided tours, and Wi‑Fi.

cards.entity_name: Actors' Playhouse at the Miracle Theatre
cards.title: Actors' Playhouse at the Miracle Theatre
cards.subtitle: Miracle Mile corridor
cards.notes: Pick a musical, drama, or children’s program from the theater calendar, then arrive via the Miracle Mile block with nearby street parking and garages.
cards.short_summary: A performing-arts destination on Miracle Mile.
cards.evidence_claim: Actors’ Playhouse lists its venue at 280 Miracle Mile and identifies nearby street parking and garages in the Miracle Mile area.
cards.source_title: Visit Us - Actors' Playhouse at the Miracle Theatre
cards.access_notes: At 280 Miracle Mile; box-office hours are published on the venue’s visit page and can change for productions.

cards.title: Giralda Plaza
cards.subtitle: Giralda Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the pedestrianized 100 block of Giralda Avenue as a short walking detour and choose among the documented restaurant or coffee-shop options there.
cards.short_summary: A pedestrian corridor lined with food and coffee businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: The City states that the 100 block of Giralda Avenue reopened as Giralda Plaza, a pedestrian walkway lined with restaurants, bars, and coffee shops.
cards.access_notes: The City identifies this as the 100 block of Giralda Ave.; select an all-ages restaurant or coffee shop.

cards.title: Venetian Pool
cards.subtitle: De Soto Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Reserve or check same-day availability before heading to De Soto Boulevard, then swim among the pool’s spring water, waterfalls, and cave-like grottos.
cards.short_summary: A public historic pool supplied by an underground aquifer.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says Venetian Pool is fed by spring water from an underground aquifer and features two waterfalls and cave-like grottos.
cards.access_notes: At 2701 De Soto Blvd.; admission is ticketed, capacity can limit same-day entry, and alcohol is not permitted.

cards.title: The Biltmore Hotel
cards.subtitle: Anastasia Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Anastasia Avenue approach to see the Mediterranean-style hotel architecture, then use the listed golf, tennis, spa, fitness, or dining facilities if desired.
cards.short_summary: A 1926-era landmark hotel with multiple documented facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes the Biltmore as a 271-room resort on more than 150 acres with Mediterranean architecture, golf, tennis, spa, fitness, and pool facilities.
cards.access_notes: At 1200 Anastasia Ave.; access to facilities and services may require a reservation or purchase.

cards.title: Matheson Hammock Park & Marina
cards.subtitle: Old Cutler Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the Old Cutler Road entrance for a nature-trail or picnic outing, and look for the tidal atoll pool and marina rather than treating the park as a pass-through.
cards.short_summary: A 630-acre park with trails, an atoll pool, and a marina.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Matheson Hammock as a 630-acre urban park with a tidal atoll pool, marina, picnic pavilions, and nature trails.
cards.source_title: Matheson Hammock Park & Marina | Coral Gables
cards.access_notes: At 9610 Old Cutler Road; the City lists vehicle entrance fees and daily hours of 8 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden
cards.subtitle: Old Cutler Road corridor
cards.notes: Buy admission for a daytime walk through the garden’s tropical plant collections, then add the Wings of the Tropics butterfly exhibit to your route.
cards.short_summary: An 83-acre garden with tropical collections and a butterfly exhibit.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairchild states that it is at 10901 Old Cutler Road, is open daily 10 a.m.–5 p.m., and includes collections, exhibits, and Wings of the Tropics.
cards.access_notes: At 10901 Old Cutler Road; general admission is required for non-members and the garden is open daily except December 25.
